player_prompt.intro:
Weebebwa Mastermind.
Weebebwa okufuna akakodyo akaliko {code_length} digiti, buli digitu okuva 1 okutu {num_numbers}, {repeats}.
Mu kujjumbira kwo, weebebwa kusubmita olungambo lwo mu fooma ifu: '[2 1 4 5]'.
Olwaleero lwa buli lungambo, weebebwa kabizo mu fooma ya pegs za blali na white.
Pegi ya blali efa ku digitu ngawulo mu kifo kyawulo, wabula pegi ya white efa ku digitu ngawulo mu kifo kisikwawulo.
Oli na {max_turns} mafumbo okufuna akakodyo.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Tewanziramu na lukalala lw'ennamba eziriko ebifo ebyayawulwamu mu bisenge ebinene.
invalid_move.not_integers: Ebintu byonna ebiriko biteekwa okuba nga bibaliramu ennamba entuufu.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Enamba zonna zirina okubeera wakati wa 1 ne {num_numbers}.

game_action.feedback: Watteeka [{guess}]. Maoni: {black_pegs} pego za kkala, {white_pegs} pego za bbululu.

outcome.win: Oli wamuwa akakodyo, olivunja {black_pegs} ku {code_length} pegs ngawulo
outcome.turn_limit: Ekigero ky'okuyunga kituuse. Otegedde {percent} ku buli kikumi eky'ennamba mu ngeri entuufu.
